svg.title: Disconnect, reconnect within grace, or forfeit
svg.desc: Use case: a player's socket drops mid-game. The seat is kept for 120 s; the same account can reclaim it from any new socket. If nobody returns, the periodic maintenance tick ends the game as abandonment and the completion flow of UML 12 saves it.
svg.text: Disconnect, reconnect within grace, or forfeit
Use case: a player's socket drops mid-game. The seat is kept for 120 s; the same account can reclaim it from any new socket.
If nobody returns, the periodic maintenance tick ends the game as abandonment and the completion flow of UML 12 saves it.
alt = if / else opt = if loop = repeat
